description: This file defines the EmployeeSavedEvent class which is an event class within the OrangeHRM PIM module. It is used to signal that an Employee entity has been saved, encapsulating the Employee object.

classes.name: EmployeeSavedEvent
classes.description: An event class that signifies an employee has been saved, containing the Employee entity data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a specific Employee object.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with the event.
